verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a legal services firm advising on fintech, venture, IP, privacy and employment matters, not a software product or platform. Asking for a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any API, and the probe found every OpenAPI path returning 404, so the exception for a shipped wrong-axis capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
